items.reflection: Paddles for a Purpose was OttoTHON's first-ever pickleball tournament. Held in a round-robin style competition accompanied by a fun-filled raffle generously donated by our sponsors, we were proud to raise $2,089 in support of Upstate Golisano Children's Hospital!
